name: Noah Weidling
original_name: ノア・ヴァイトリング
source:
The neighboring Republic's President.
He eradicated poverty, stabilized politics, built a sustainable society, and boosted the nation's level of happiness, all on his own.
As politicians go, he's pretty much perfect, and has a 100% approval rate.

[From Digital Artwork book]
